purpose: Offline-verifiable historical replay package corrected under ADR-0008
claim_scope: One bounded non-clinical historical case; no generalized clinical, causation, or lead-time claim

integrity.hash_input: Exact repository file bytes with no normalization
integrity.path_policy: Every CAPTURED_REPLAY path is relative, resolves inside capture_root, and is committed with the manifest
integrity.live_public_rule: LIVE_PUBLIC sources have no frozen capture path or expected hash; each runtime observation hashes its own timestamped response

chronology.publication_to_geo_linkage_rule: Verify PMID 39779848 and DOI 10.1038/s41586-024-08349-1, then verify the Nature Data availability statement names GSE248438; do not require the GEO page current linked PMID to equal the qualifying PMID
chronology.exact_row_temporal_boundary: The exact XLSX row is verified only as present in bytes captured at 2026-08-16T23:18:35Z. No claim is made that the same row-level file existed on the GEO public date.

negative_controls.negative_geometry: Outside exons 15-26; no exact source-row match
Exon 10, outside exons 15-26; no exact source-row match

exact_functional_row.temporal_limitation: The captured workbook proves current row presence only; it does not prove row-level availability on 2024-09-27.
exact_functional_row.authority_limitation: These are source values, not a Recall classification, threshold, or clinical decision.

ncbi_public_record.conditions: Preserve NCBI attribution and the medical-information disclaimer; NCBI cannot transfer rights that may remain with submitters. Re-review terms before public release.

ncbi_bibliographic_metadata.conditions: Retain ESummary bibliographic metadata only. Do not treat PubMed availability as permission to redistribute an abstract or article.

ncbi_molecular_data.conditions: NCBI places no restriction on molecular-data use or distribution, but NCBI cannot transfer rights that may remain with submitters. Preserve accession, source locator, and attribution.

springer_nature_minimal_excerpt.conditions: Retain and redistribute only the 15-word accession-linkage excerpt with identifiers and citation for this non-commercial audit package. No article, abstract, figure, table, or supplement is retained. Re-review terms before public release.
